title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Respect for the Tribunal
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: Following a highly contested trial in Small Claims Court, the judge renders an oral judgment entirely against the paralegal's client. The paralegal immediately starts shouting at the judge, arguing that the judgment is foolish. What rule is violated?
options: The duty to the tribunal to maintain a courteous and respectful attitude.
The duty to encourage public respect for the administration of justice.
questions.explain: Rule 4.01 requires a paralegal to represent the client resolutely but always with courtesy and respect for the tribunal. Arguing with a judge after a ruling has been rendered—especially in an abusive manner—violates this duty, as well as Rule 2.01 (encouraging respect for the administration of justice).
